According to Civiqs, an organization that surveys thousands of Americans daily about their views on politics and current events, Tennessee switched to having a negative approval rating of the president in early September, and the gap has only grown since.

At the beginning of September, Civiqs recorded Trump with a net approval rating of 1% in the state, and it has now flipped to a net approval rating of -4% as of Sept. 12.
